page.title: Classification rules
page.description: {total} rules, {builtIn} built-in and {custom} custom. Built-in rules can be switched on or off; to change what they match, add a custom rule with a higher priority.
page.descriptionError: The rules that decide a log source's class.
page.errorTitle: Classification rules could not be shown.

page.precedenceNote: The first level that decides wins. Within a level the highest priority wins; two rules of equal priority naming different classes leave the level undecided, record a conflict, and the next level is tried.
